data.gender_notes: Jaden is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Jaden is of Hebrew origin, derived from the Hebrew name Hehanias, which means 'God's gift'. In the Bible, this name is borne by the prophet Hananiah, who was a descendant of the priest Eliakim. Hananiah prophesied to King Zedekiah of Judah, encouraging him not to be afraid of the Babylonians, who were besieging Jerusalem. Though Hananiah's words were comforting, they ultimately proved false, and he was put in the stocks in the temple for his false prophecy. Despite this setback, the name Jaden remains a reminder of the precious gifts God bestows upon us, even in the midst of challenges and trials.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of God's grace and favor
data.etymology: Jaden belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “God's gift.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Jaden total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.
